O.content: The blue line rises on the page from its point at Q1 to its point at Q2, is horizontal from Q2 to Q3, and rises again from Q3 to Q4.
The vertical axis is literally labeled “Revenue.”
The horizontal axis is literally labeled “Quarter,” with Q1 at the left and Q4 at the right.

B.text: If the horizontal axis orders Q1 through Q4 chronologically, the vertical axis encodes Revenue with higher page position representing greater revenue, and the workflow routes an overall rise from the first to final quarter to the growth response, then select the growth route.
B.conditions: Assumes the plotted line is Company C revenue and that an overall first-to-last increase—not the title’s wording or an unstated threshold—defines growth; no explicit routing policy is supplied.
